verdict.rationale: The evidence presents WorkOS only as a hosted SaaS platform. Nothing documents a self-managed deployment, a private or dedicated instance, or storing user data in the customer's own database. Vault's BYOK covers encryption keys rather than where the auth system runs, so it is adjacent and earns no credit, and community comments note that login data lives in WorkOS's database.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can control where the auth system and its user data run — self-managed deployment, private instance, or my own database
